summary: Pull-request, merge-queue and non-main-branch runs restore caches and write none; only refs/heads/main writes. Task 1 probes (throwaway branch probe/infra-584-cache-mode in sjawhar/legion) whether GitHub accepts an expression in cache-mode: Arm A = `cache-mode: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'write' || 'read' }}` workflow-level in pr-and-main.yaml, envoy-and-contracts.yaml, docs.yaml and job-level on worker-image.yaml's build job; Arm B = per-step gating (actions/cache/restore+save for go-notices, setup-go move-aside step at the six caching sites, setup-bun wrapper no-cache on non-main, check-image-trigger-paths and check-bun-version updates). Common: worker-image cache-from/to `scope=worker-image`, cache-to empty unless main (mode=max kept); go-notices restore-keys `go-notices-${{ runner.os }}-`; comments and docs/kubernetes.md:500-501.

tasks.task: Probe cache-mode expressions on a throwaway branch (two workflow files, positive control job evaluating to write); record 'Cache mode:' and save lines for actions/cache@55cc834, setup-go@b7ad1da, ./.github/actions/setup-bun; delete probe caches and branch. Arm A only if the wf job reads `read` with all saves skipped and the positive job reads `write` with a save; otherwise Arm B.

Edit per the arm and the common changes; run check-image-trigger-paths.sh, check-action-pins.sh, check-bun-version.sh, check-release-credentials.sh and the .test.sh of each edited script; YAML-parse every edited file.
Open the pull request (body line `Dispatch: INFRA-584`); all four edited workflows run on it and are the pre-merge proof.
Measure AC4 with the jobs API (formula in plan.md) and write the before/after table into the PR body, including the case where a second push to the same PR is slower.
Post-merge production check: AC1 query, main-still-writes query, AC2 usage samples, AC3 p90 query; one-off delete of pre-merge refs/pull/* entries if the architect chooses it and the App may.

acceptance.criterion: 1. No pull-request run writes a cache entry
acceptance.surface: GitHub Actions in sjawhar/legion: this PR's runs, then every PR run after the merge
acceptance.command: gh api --paginate "repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/caches?ref=refs/pull/N/merge&per_page=100" --jq '.actions_caches|length' (0); after merge: gh api --paginate "repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/caches?per_page=100&sort=created_at&direction=desc" --jq '.actions_caches[] | select((.ref|startswith("refs/pull/")) and .created_at > "<merge time>")' (empty)
acceptance.negativeControl: another open PR without the change lists new entries under its refs/pull/<m>/merge in the same hours

acceptance.criterion: 2. Cache under 9 GB for 3 days after merge
acceptance.command: gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/cache/usage --jq .active_caches_size_in_bytes < 9000000000 at merge+1h and at least every 24h to merge+72h
acceptance.dependsOn: architect's decision on the repository storage limit / one-off delete (plan.md, 'What AC2 needs beyond this pull request')

acceptance.criterion: 3. Lint notices step p90 < 3 min for 3 days after merge
acceptance.surface: GitHub Actions jobs API, pr-and-main.yaml lint job
acceptance.command: for successful lint jobs of runs created >= merge time and < merge+72h, step named 'Check every Go release archive's third-party notices…' completed_at-started_at; p90 < 180 s

acceptance.criterion: 4. PR states measured minutes saved per PR push, before and after
acceptance.command: jobs API medians: Worker Image build job (last 30 PR runs before vs this PR's runs, plus first 10 PR runs after merge), Tests lint job and its cache post/save step, setup-go post steps of typecheck and test

findings.finding: mode=min on main is outside the spec, unsupported (the 12-of-17-minute export came from a cold build) and would rebuild every intermediate stage
findings.answer: Dropped: mode=max stays; the plan only gates cache-to on main and gives the worker its own scope.

findings.finding: Worker image and listener share the default BuildKit scope on main; the 0 CACHED main build may be the listener's index displacing the worker's
findings.answer: Checked run order (listener docker job ended 21:18:47Z, worker imported at 22:17:47Z with 0 CACHED); plan sets scope=worker-image on cache-from and cache-to, recorded as departure 2.

findings.finding: AC2 cannot be met by the spec's changes alone; 13 GB of PR entries outlive the window; listener writes count; storage cap is a new requirement with unverified feasibility
findings.answer: Plan states it with measurements and sends the architect a decision: storage limit by the repository owner (recommended), one-off delete of pre-merge PR entries, or a changed AC2; listener stays INFRA-522's (#2297). AC2 command and sampling defined (GB = 10^9 bytes).

findings.finding: Arm A rests on unchecked facts: expression support, workflow_call, which actions honour cache-mode; setup-qemu does not run on PRs; probe location
findings.answer: Probe covers actions/cache v6.1.0, setup-go v7.0.0 and the setup-bun wrapper with a positive control; worker-image gets job-level cache-mode (called workflow); setup-qemu claim corrected; probe runs in sjawhar/legion on a throwaway push-triggered branch (the planner App was refused workflow writes, the sandbox legion-smoke is not readable by it); Arm B if the probe cannot run.

findings.finding: Nothing checks that main still writes
findings.answer: Added the 'Main still writes' post-merge check with keys and query.

findings.finding: Arm B hidden requirements: NON_BUILDING_ACTIONS lacks actions/cache/restore and save; setup-go sites undercounted; bun cannot be restored everywhere; design rule
findings.answer: Arm B extends NON_BUILDING_ACTIONS with a test case; the six caching setup-go sites named (seven others cache nothing); bun departure recorded (departure 3); the move-aside step reuses no result, it only prevents a save.

findings.finding: AC1 needs a precise query and a ruling on open PRs that edit these files
findings.answer: Paginated, created_at-filtered query defined; a PR's run uses its merge commit with main, so every PR carries the rule from its next push; coordination notes for #2316, #2305, #2297, INFRA-583.

findings.finding: AC4 has several readings and may be negative
findings.answer: Formula fixed (runner minutes per job and per step, medians, named samples, Worker Image separately) and the slower second-push case must be stated.

findings.finding: AC3 has no baseline and no query
findings.answer: Baseline p90 14.8 min from the parent's measurement artifact; jobs-API query with the step-name prefix and p90 < 180 s.

findings.finding: Event vs ref reading of the spec's worker-image line

findings.answer: Buildkit failure cited to Docker's docs ('Cache write restrictions'); the probe records the actual skip text for actions/cache v6.1.0.
